name: Locking Door

stealth.details: to notice the door sway slightly, even though there's no breeze

disable: DC 14 Athletics check to push back against the door, DC 14 Crafting check to wedge the door open, or DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to jam the lock or open the lock afterward

items.name: Shut In
items.text:
Trigger A creature ends their move after passing through the doorway

---

Effect With an ethereal gust shimmering in the air, the door creaks as it swings shut and locks. The haunted door pushes anyone in its space into an adjacent space in the connecting chamber. A creature that would be pushed and succeeds at a DC 16 Reflex save save selects which side of the door they end up on.

text: A door (or other portal) slams shut and locks.
